'''July 2001 Fort Worth tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Fort Worth, Texas in July 2001. It is known from Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2805">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-07-austin-tx-8-4-01-double-trd2805/ austin-tx-8-4-01-double-tr], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 7 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-07-austin-tx-8-4-01-double-trd2805/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' July 2001
* '''Site:''' Fort Worth, Texas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
